name: Project Overview

native.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prj_projects WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM prj_tasks WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY status

cards.name: Task Quá Hạn Theo Dự Án

native.query: SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) as overdue FROM prj_tasks t JOIN prj_projects p ON p.id = t.project_id WHERE t.due_date < NOW() AND t.status NOT IN ('DONE','CANCELLED') AND t.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY overdue DESC
